thread:
maria: Hey team — need prod deploy for release v2.3.1 today during change window 18:00 UTC. Canary + DB migrate. Who can grant deployer role? I don't have prod deploy perms (MFA prompting fails).

deploy-bot: Deploy queue created: release=v2.3.1 env=prod window=2026-04-15T18:00Z. Requirements: 'deployer' role & active MFA. Run `/request-elev --role deployer --reason \"release v2.3.1\"` to request JIT.

sam: I tried `/request-elev` but it errors: 'MFA not enrolled for user'. Getting `403: mfa_required`.

security-sre: If you need JIT, @maria you can request temporary via self-serve but ops needs to approve. Security needs audit line for DB migration — include migration ticket ID.

maria: Ok running command now:
```
/request-elev --role deployer --duration 30m --reason \"canary deploy + migrate #ENG-2245\"
```
Command returned: pending_approval.

oncall-rotation: Approving temporary elevation for @maria for 30m. Please only run canary and stop if errors. I'll watch logs.

deploy-bot: Elevation granted to maria for 30m. Token expiry at 2026-04-15T18:30Z. Note: deployer role grants access to prod clusters; all actions are audited. :lock: :white_check_mark: 

alex: Heads up — the release manifest has model-service pinned to 2.3.0. Need to pin to 2.3.1 to include the migration flag, otherwise schema mismatch. maria can you confirm pin?

maria: Confirmed, updating manifest and pushing to release branch.

sam: Also reminder: if canary fails auto-rollback policy will revert to 2.3.0 and notify oncall. Rollback steps (if manual needed):
`kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-service -n prod --to-revision=<previous>`
and then re-run db rollback script: `scripts/db/rollback_v2_3.sh`

deploy-bot: Starting canary (10% traffic) for model-service@2.3.1 — canary id: cb-4821. Watch: https://deploys.redwood.example/canary/cb-4821

maria: Canary logs look ok so far. Latency stable.

deploy-bot: :warning: Canary cb-4821 observed 5% error rate > threshold (2%) — auto-rollback triggered.

maria: :disappointed: Ok rolling back. Not opening incident yet — sounds like expected fallback. Will create postmortem and include repro steps.

oncall-rotation: Agree — not a Sev given auto-rollback, but collect logs. @security-sre please keep audit trail.

security-sre: Got it. Saving audit export and flagging migration schema change for review. One note: need to triage MFA enrollment flow — multiple folks hit `mfa_required` today.

alex: I'll open a quick ticket to check deployer role boundary and MFA UX: ENG-3321.

maria: Thanks everyone — re-scheduling release after fixes. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
